description: Work out the UPI merchant discount rate (MDR) that NPCI has announced but not yet started: 0.4% on person-to-merchant UPI payments above ₹2,000 (capped at ₹300), a flat ₹5 for essential-sector merchants and 0.02% for capital markets. It was due on 15 October 2026, but NPCI deferred it to a date it has not announced yet, so no MDR applies today; the tool shows what the fee will be once it starts. Person-to-person payments, payments of ₹2,000 or less and small P2PM merchants (up to ₹1 lakh a month) will pay nothing. Shows the 18% GST on the MDR and what the merchant would keep.

category.description: standard merchant (default), essential sector, capital markets, or p2p (person to person).

gst_registered.description: true if the merchant is GST-registered and can claim the GST on MDR as input tax credit.

small_merchant.description: true if the UPI ID is a small P2PM merchant (up to ₹1 lakh a month on UPI QR).

name: calculate_upi_mdr
title: Calculate UPI MDR
